subject: add-index: use max-node-count as hint when split subtasks on nextgen (#63861)
summary: Diff-only change in `pkg/ddl/backfilling_dist_scheduler.go`: in NextGen builds, `LitBackfillScheduler.OnNextSubtasksBatch` now uses `max(task.MaxNodeCount, 1)` as the planning hint (`nodeCnt`) instead of `len(execIDs)` when splitting backfill/merge subtasks, and logs `node-count`. Checked callers/contract: `pkg/ddl/index.go` passes DDL reorg `MaxNodeCount` into `handle.SubmitTask`, and `pkg/disttask/framework/scheduler/scheduler.go` guarantees `execIDs` is non-empty before calling `OnNextSubtasksBatch`; no Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL state/metadata handling. `upstream/master` retains the same `nodeCnt` logic (no later fix/revert indicating a hidden bug).
